$comment: Teaching level 1: Raise Land. The shrine sits on an islet across a strait; the Shaper must lift a ridge to reach it.
name: The Narrow Water
description: A shrine waits on the islet across the strait. Walk your Shaper to the shore and Raise Land toward it, then send three followers to pray.

rewards.text: The shrine answers: two Bolts are yours to cast.

objectives.text: Pray at the shrine across the strait within ten minutes

do.text: Walk the Shaper to the eastern shore and Raise Land toward the islet.
Strait still open? Raise Land recharges from your mana; cast it from the very edge of the shore.
The tide turns at ten minutes. If you are stuck, restart the level from the pause menu.
